caption: The drawing shows the back view of a long, decorative dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt, depicted with fine black linework on a beige background. The dress features short puffed sleeves ending in ruffled cuffs, a rounded neckline with a ruffled collar, and a large bow tied at the waist in the back. The skirt has multiple layers and is adorned with several horizontal ruffles and decorative trims, including a central vertical ruffle line that divides the back of the skirt into two symmetrical sections. The bottom edge of the skirt is finished with a wide ruffled hem, and the lines suggest the fabric is gathered and draped, creating volume and shape. There is no color or shading present other than the monochrome black lines on the light background.
title: Dress
